title: 第1章
content_zh: HK001 重生六年前夏国边境，东单市。一处临海的阴暗仓库中，环形桌上摆放着七八台电脑主机，十多个显示器，还有一台十分先进的民用服务器。除了这些之外，还有一把已装消声器的黑色卡宾枪M4A1，与一条装了四个弹夹的战术腰带。一名戴着眼镜，脸色苍白，眼神却十分犀利的年轻男子，坐在转椅上，有条不紊的敲击着键盘。键盘旁边，安静的躺着一把Clock18手枪，黑色的枪身，以及哑光的消声器，显示出一丝丝危险。这名男子，名叫石磊，绰号石头、石头怪、石头哥......石磊戴着蓝牙耳塞，目光划过最右侧的四个屏幕。屏幕上，显示着仓库四周的情况，还有进入仓库的小巷子，以及仓库周围天空的影像。一个独立的屏幕，显示着仓库旁边，一条小巷子中，停着一辆公路高速摩托，这是石磊以防万一准备的逃生工具。这些图像均十分清晰，显然动用了高清监视摄像机！‘一切正常！’石磊心中暗筹，没有发生任何意外。“嘟嘟嘟~~~”蓝牙耳机发出轻微的声音，石磊在蓝牙耳机上按了一下。“一号，是否准备完毕？”一股电子编译变声后的声音，从蓝牙耳机中，钻入石磊的耳朵。“一号准备完毕，猎鹰请指示！”石磊的声音，同样经过了电子编译变声，才会经过蓝牙耳机发射出去。“一号，等待猎鹰命令！”“一号明白！”石磊说完后，忍不住道：“呼叫猎鹰！”“一号，有什么情况？”即使经过了电子编译变声，猎鹰的语气中，也能听出不满。“猎鹰，一号申请独立通讯！”“嘟嘟嘟~~~”“一号，独立通讯建立，有什么情况汇报？”猎鹰的语气很严肃。石磊苍白的脸上，泛起一道病态的潮红。“猎鹰，这件事之后，组织会答应我，帮我出手一次吧？”“住口！”猎鹰暴怒道：“一号，现在正在执行任务，有什么事情，以后再说！”“嘀~~~~”独立通信被切断，然后石磊又被载入常规通信频道。石磊双手捏着拳头，深深吸气，胸口起伏不定，怒火不停酝酿。‘希望组织能够守信，否则....’‘手中的那些资料，也足够组织喝一壶了吧！’东单市以东，沃桑国和利坚国，正在举行联合舰队演习。这两个世界军事大国，向整个世界，展现出强大的军事实力。利坚国的航空母舰，舰载海基飞机，舰载无人飞机，沃桑国的两栖登陆舰，还有单兵辅助系统，均会投入演习。利坚国的航空母舰上，一架架舰载无人飞机，首先飞上天空，进行先期侦查探测，以及消灭演习目标等。整整十架捕食者无人飞机，在天空中无声无息的飞行着。航空母舰甲板上，舰载海基战斗机，随着演习的进行，也从甲板升空。沃桑国的两栖登陆舰，靠近假想敌岛屿，在利坚国飞机的掩护下，进行登陆作战。两个世界军事大国，表现出来的战斗力，让世界震惊！然而，另一件让世界更加震惊的事情，正在发生。“呼叫一号，侵入拉基米号数据链！”石磊的双手，快速在键盘上跳动，如同两只舞动的蝴蝶。“报告猎鹰，成功侵入数据链，共享连接打开！”拉基米号，正是利坚国的航空母舰！石磊，正是世界顶尖级黑客之一！他所代表的组织，正在入侵世界最顶级的两个军事大国，企图从远程控制利坚国航空母舰的部分权限，获取一些资料。“呼叫一号，模拟拉基米号正常通讯命令！”“一号收到！”石磊紧张的操作着键盘，普通情况下，即使有顶尖超级电脑支持，从外部入侵航空母舰这样的壮举，也几乎不可能！但石磊所在的组织，居然硬生生的从利坚国的拉基米号航母，获得了一个远程登录的权限。如此一来，入侵变得不那么艰难。‘嘿嘿，利坚国的航空母舰防御，也没有传说中那么强大！’石磊完成了猎鹰的命令，还有闲工夫，在拉基米号航空母舰操作系统中闲逛。“呼叫一号，破解通讯密码！”猎鹰的最新命令传来，石磊差点气得吐血。破解通讯密码？开什么国际大玩笑！航空母舰的通讯密码，安全等级极高，依靠他这几台破电脑，还有一台民用高级服务器，想要破解密码，无疑是痴人说梦！“报告猎鹰，请重复命令！”石磊还以为是猎鹰的命令，传达错误，将其他成员的命令，传达到了他这里。他所在的组织，神通广大，能量极强！否则，也不会打联合演习的主意！“一号，破解拉基米号通讯密码！重复命令，破解拉基米号通讯密码！”石磊脑门的汗水，一下子就冒了出来。‘死就死吧！’石磊的十指，带起了一道道残影，快速在键盘上敲击。整个仓库中，顿时只剩下机箱呜呜的电扇声，以及啪啪啪的键盘敲击声。“叮咚叮咚叮咚！！！！”蓝牙耳机中，传来了急促的警报声。中间的电脑屏幕上，跳出一条红色警告。拉基米号的电子信息安全人员，已经发现破解工作，正在进行反向追踪！如果放在平时，石磊铁定立马开始收尾，消除入侵痕迹，然后放弃肉鸡跑路。但这一次是组织的集体行动，如果他这一环失败，其他人员绝对也会失败。组织上追究责任，石磊绝对难辞其咎！对于神秘莫测的组织，石磊有一股深深的恐惧！若是这一次搞砸了，他绝对会被‘神秘失踪’。“妈.的，拼了！”石磊快速建立远程连接，连接进入到他预先准备的备用服务器上，扩大了计算能力，进攻更加犀利！“呼叫猎鹰，请求支援！”猎鹰的声音中，也带着一丝慌乱。“坚持！”“一号，坚持三十秒！”石磊苦笑，刚刚还在嘲笑拉基米号多么垃圾，如今被对方发现，才知道对方有多么厉害。或许对方在入侵和进攻方面，远远不如他，但对方在追踪的技术上，简直是登峰造极！“又被干掉了一台！”“还有三台中转服务器！”中转服务器即是高级肉鸡。“最多还能够坚持十五秒至二十秒！”石磊自言自语着，原本苍白的脸色，更加苍白，额头冒出密密麻麻的汗迹。“啪啪~~”机械键盘的响声，几乎连成了一片。“呼叫猎鹰，五秒之后，即将暴露！”猎鹰没有任何回应，直接切断了蓝牙耳机。“滋滋滋~~”蓝牙耳机中，传出一阵盲音。“警告！发现未知物体，正在高速接近！”仓库房顶，高清监控摄像机，锁定着空中一颗黑色的小颗粒。石磊盯着电脑屏幕，脸色越来越难看。这个监控程序是石磊自己编写的，在图形处理方面，石磊有着独到的见解。比如现在，高清监控摄像机能够通过画面中，黑点的大小变化，计算出对应的距离，以及速度。拉基米号航空母舰上，电子信息安全人员成功追踪到石磊。航空母舰连接着外太空的‘锁眼’光学卫星，并且结合全球定位系统，精确锁定了石磊的位置。“噢，见鬼！”“吉米，你看看，那是什么！”电子信息安全办公室中，几个信息安全人员，看着锁眼卫星传来的图像。突然，办公室的门被推开。一名无人机操作员，脸色惨白的大吼道：“快查查，无人机的控制权限被变更！”吉米捂着额头，哀嚎了一声。“Oh.shit！”仓库中，石磊看着越来越近的黑点，高清监控摄像机，终于将黑点的全貌，展现在石磊面前。石磊看清的一瞬间，浑身的力量，仿佛刹那被抽离。“捕食者！”“海尔法！”“卧槽.....”两秒钟之后，仓库发生了剧烈的爆炸！因为，捕食者是MQ－1型无人机，海尔法是机载反坦克导弹！石磊被组织抛弃！他准备的武器，根本没有派上用途。他准备的逃生路线，也没有发挥作用。死亡的一瞬间，石磊想了很多很多。他是孤儿，为了寻找父母的消息，他迷恋上了黑客技术。也是因为黑客技术，他如今丧命。石磊还想到，他的祖国，夏国，或许会和利坚国与沃桑国，关系更加恶化！这一切都是那个神秘组织，在背后的推手！他从始至终，也只是一枚棋子！只是可惜了啊，他没有报仇的机会。意念消失的一瞬间，石磊突然想起一句经典的话。‘我只是想做一个好人，为什么不给我一个机会？’石磊死了，管不了夏国、利坚国与沃桑国的外交.纠纷，也管不了利坚国导弹轰击夏国城市的骇人听闻。外太空，一道漆黑的空间裂缝，无声无息的展开。一团神秘的紫色光芒，从空间裂缝飞了出来，射向蓝色的地球。“Searching.The.City.of.Miracles......”“Not.found.....”“Saerching.The.Magic.Net......”“Not.found.....”“Destruct.system.loading......”“Found.Inheritor......”神秘的光团，传递出未知的信息，如果有精通克伦蒂亚世界，人类通用语言的专家存在，那么一定能够准确的知道以上的信息。搜寻奇迹之城......未发现.......搜寻魔网......未发现......自毁系统正在加载......发现传承者......二零零六年，八月三十一日，夏国，双庆市，双庆大学。石磊带着一个傻不拉几的银边眼镜，穿着廉价的T恤和牛仔裤，拉着一个行李箱，一脸诡异的站在校门前！————————————————————————————————PS：新书上传，需要一切支持！点击、推荐、收藏、一切！
content_en: HK001 Rebirth Six years ago, on the border of Xia Kingdom, Dongdan City. In a dark warehouse near the sea, there are seven or eight computer hosts, more than ten monitors, and a very advanced civilian server placed on a circular table. In addition to these, there is also a black carbine M4A1 with a silencer installed, and a tactical belt with four magazines. A young man wearing glasses, with a pale face and sharp eyes, sat on a swivel chair and typed on the keyboard methodically. Next to the keyboard, a Clock18 pistol lay quietly. The black gun body and matte silencer showed a hint of danger. This man's name is Shi Lei, nicknamed Stone, Stone Monster, Stone Brother... Shi Lei is wearing Bluetooth earbuds and his eyes are crossing the four screens on the far right. On the screen, the situation around the warehouse was displayed, as well as the alley leading into the warehouse, and images of the sky surrounding the warehouse. An independent screen showed a highway motorcycle parked in a small alley next to the warehouse. This was Shi Lei's escape tool prepared just in case. These images are very clear, clearly using high-definition surveillance cameras! ‘Everything is fine! ’ Shi Lei secretly thought that nothing unexpected happened. "Beep beep~~~" The Bluetooth headset made a slight sound, and Shi Lei clicked on the Bluetooth headset. "No. 1, are you ready?" An electronically compiled voice penetrated into Shi Lei's ears from the Bluetooth headset. "No. 1 is ready, Falcon, please give instructions!" Shi Lei's voice was also electronically compiled and changed before being emitted through the Bluetooth headset. "No. 1, wait for Falcon's order!" "No. 1 understands!" After Shi Lei finished speaking, he couldn't help but said: "Call Falcon!" "No. 1, what's going on?" Even after the electronic compilation and change of voice, dissatisfaction could be heard in Falcon's tone. "Falcon, No. 1 applied for independent communication!" "Dududu~~~" "No. 1, independent communication has been established. What is the situation to report?" Falcon's tone was very serious. A sickly flush appeared on Shi Lei's pale face. "Falcon, after this incident, the organization will promise me to help me once, right?" "Shut up!" Falcon said angrily: "No. 1, we are on a mission now. If anything happens, we will talk about it later!" "Beep~~~~" The independent communication was cut off, and then Shi Lei was loaded into the regular communication channel. Shi Lei clenched his fists with both hands and took a deep breath. His chest was rising and falling, and his anger kept brewing. ‘I hope the organization can keep its word, otherwise...’ ‘The information in hand is enough for the organization to drink from it! ’ To the east of Dongdan City, the Wosang Kingdom and the Lijian Kingdom are holding a joint fleet exercise. These two world military powers have demonstrated their strong military strength to the entire world. Lijian's aircraft carrier, ship-based sea-based aircraft, carrier-based unmanned aircraft, Wasang's amphibious landing ship, and individual auxiliary systems will all be put into the exercise. On Li Jian's aircraft carrier, ship-borne unmanned aircraft flew into the sky first to conduct advance reconnaissance and detection, as well as to eliminate exercise targets. A total of ten Predator drones were flying silently in the sky. On the deck of the aircraft carrier, carrier-based sea-based fighter jets also took off from the deck as the exercise progressed. The amphibious landing ship of the Wasang Kingdom approached the imaginary enemy island and carried out landing operations under the cover of the Lijian Kingdom's aircraft. The combat effectiveness displayed by the two world's major military powers shocked the world! However, another thing that shocked the world even more was happening. "Call number one, invade the data link of Lakimi!" Shi Lei's hands danced quickly on the keyboard, like two dancing butterflies. "Report Falcon, successfully invaded the data link, and the shared connection is opened!" The Lakimi is the aircraft carrier of Li Jian! Shi Lei is one of the world's top hackers! The organization he represents is invading the two top military powers in the world, trying to obtain some information by remotely controlling part of the Lijian aircraft carrier. "Call No. 1, simulate the normal communication command of the Lakimi!" "Received on No. 1!" Shi Lei nervously operated the keyboard. Under normal circumstances, even with the support of a top supercomputer, a feat like invading an aircraft carrier from the outside would be almost impossible! But Shi Lei's organization actually obtained a remote login permission from Li Jian's aircraft carrier Lakimi. In this way, invasion becomes less difficult. ‘Hey, Li Jian’s aircraft carrier defense is not as strong as the legend says! ’ Shi Lei completed Falcon’s order and still had some free time to hang out in the operating system of the USS Lakimi. "Call number one, crack the communication code!" Falcon's latest order came, and Shi Lei almost vomited blood in anger. Cracking communication passwords? What an international joke! The communication password of the aircraft carrier has an extremely high security level. Relying on his broken computers and a high-end civilian server, it is undoubtedly a dream to crack the password! "Report to Falcon, please repeat the order!" Shi Lei thought it was Falcon's order and miscommunicated it, so the orders of other members were conveyed to him. The organization he belongs to has vast magical powers and extremely powerful energy! Otherwise, there would be no idea of ​​joint exercises! "No. 1, crack the communication code of the Lakimi! Repeat the order and crack the communication code of the Lakimi!" Sweat suddenly appeared on Shi Lei's forehead. ‘Just die! ’ Shi Lei’s ten fingers brought up afterimages, and he quickly tapped on the keyboard. In the entire warehouse, the only sounds left were the whirring fan of the chassis and the clicking of the keyboard. "Ding dong ding dong ding dong!!!" A rapid alarm sound came from the Bluetooth headset. A red warning popped up on the computer screen in the middle. The electronic information security personnel of the Lakimi have discovered the cracking work and are conducting reverse tracking!
